## Network Trends

History assembled from a snapshot of the routing tables taken every fifteen
minutes. These are trends over time, not the live picture; for current state
see the [status page](status.qmd).

<div id="trends-summary" class="status-card metric-grid">
  <div class="metric"><strong>Tracking since:</strong> <span id="t-since">...</span></div>
  <div class="metric"><strong>Snapshots:</strong> <span id="t-snaps">...</span></div>
  <div class="metric"><strong>Distinct nodes seen:</strong> <span id="t-nodes">...</span></div>
  <div class="metric"><strong>Active peers now:</strong> <span id="t-peers">...</span></div>
</div>

## Peer Scorecard

How reliably each peer has been reachable, and how many nodes it can itself
reach (its horizon, from its own routing table).

<div id="peers-container" class="panel">
  <p>Loading...</p>
</div>

---

## Node Stability

What fraction of snapshots each node has appeared in. A stable core is always
present; the marginal ones flicker in and out, and are the routes a stricter
quality threshold would drop first.

<div id="stability-container" class="panel">
  <p>Loading...</p>
</div>

---

## Peer Overlap (latest snapshot)

How much the peers duplicate each other. Unique contribution is how many nodes
are reachable through exactly one peer. These numbers are a point-in-time
reading and they move; see the notebook post [Packet Networks and Protein
Networks](https://g0lft.org/notebook-posts/2026-07-24-packet-networks-and-protein-networks/2026-07-24-packet-networks-and-protein-networks.html)
on g0lft.org for why.

<div id="overlap-container" class="panel">
  <p>Loading...</p>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4"></script>

<script>
const BASE = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk";
const NODE_COLOUR = "#1f77b4";   // AXIP blue, matches the rest of the site
const PEER_COLOUR = "#2ca02c";   // RF green

function fmtTs(iso) {
  // "2026-07-25T11:45:31" -> "25 11:45" (day + HH:MM, UTC)
  const d = new Date(iso + "Z");
  const day = String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  const hh = String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, "0");
  const mm = String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${day} ${hh}:${mm}`;
}

async function loadTrends() {
  try {
    const [timelineR, peersR, stabilityR, overlapR] = await Promise.all([
      fetch(BASE + "/history/timeline?hours=48"),
      fetch(BASE + "/history/peers"),
      fetch(BASE + "/history/stability"),
      fetch(BASE + "/history/overlap"),
    ]);

    const timeline = (await timelineR.json()).timeline || [];
    const peers = (await peersR.json()).peers || [];
    const stability = await stabilityR.json();
    const overlap = await overlapR.json();

    /* ---- summary ---- */
    if (timeline.length) {
      document.getElementById("t-since").innerText = fmtTs(timeline[0].ts) + " UTC";
      document.getElementById("t-peers").innerText = timeline[timeline.length - 1].peers;
    }
    document.getElementById("t-snaps").innerText = stability.total_snapshots ?? "—";
    document.getElementById("t-nodes").innerText = (stability.nodes || []).length;

    /* ---- timeline chart ---- */
    new Chart(document.getElementById("timelineChart"), {
      type: "line",
      data: {
        labels: timeline.map(p => fmtTs(p.ts)),
        datasets: [
          {
            label: "Nodes visible", data: timeline.map(p => p.nodes),
            borderColor: NODE_COLOUR, backgroundColor: NODE_COLOUR,
            yAxisID: "yNodes", tension: 0.25, pointRadius: 0, borderWidth: 2,
          },
          {
            label: "Active peers", data: timeline.map(p => p.peers),
            borderColor: PEER_COLOUR, backgroundColor: PEER_COLOUR,
            yAxisID: "yPeers", tension: 0.25, pointRadius: 0, borderWidth: 2,
            stepped: true,
          },
        ],
      },
      options: {
        responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, interaction: { mode: "index", intersect: false },
        scales: {
          x: { ticks: { maxTicksLimit: 10, autoSkip: true }, title: { display: true, text: "day HH:MM UTC" } },
          yNodes: { position: "left", beginAtZero: true, title: { display: true, text: "nodes" } },
          yPeers: { position: "right", beginAtZero: true, suggestedMax: 6, grid: { drawOnChartArea: false }, title: { display: true, text: "peers" }, ticks: { stepSize: 1 } },
        },
      },
    });

    /* ---- peer scorecard ---- */
    document.getElementById("peers-container").innerHTML = `
      <table class="table-dashboard">
        <thead><tr><th>Peer</th><th>Uptime</th><th>Seen</th><th>Reach (nodes it can see)</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          ${peers.map(p => `
            <tr>
              <td style="font-weight:bold;">${p.peer}</td>
              <td>${p.uptime_pct}%</td>
              <td>${p.snapshots_seen} / ${p.snapshots_total}</td>
              <td>${p.reach ?? "—"}</td>
            </tr>`).join("")}
        </tbody>
      </table>`;

    /* ---- node stability ---- */
    const nodes = stability.nodes || [];
    const core = nodes.filter(n => n.pct === 100).length;
    const marginal = nodes.filter(n => n.pct < 50);
    document.getElementById("stability-container").innerHTML = `
      <div class="metric-grid" style="margin-bottom:10px;">
        <div class="metric"><strong>Stable core (every snapshot):</strong> ${core}</div>
        <div class="metric"><strong>Marginal (&lt; 50%):</strong> ${marginal.length}</div>
        <div class="metric"><strong>Total tracked:</strong> ${nodes.length}</div>
      </div>
      <p class="text-muted">The marginal nodes, least stable first:</p>
      <table class="table-dashboard">
        <thead><tr><th>Node</th><th>Present in</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          ${marginal.map(n => `<tr><td>${n.node}</td><td>${n.pct}%</td></tr>`).join("")}
        </tbody>
      </table>`;

    /* ---- overlap ---- */
    const contrib = overlap.contribution || [];
    const pairs = overlap.pairwise || [];
    document.getElementById("overlap-container").innerHTML = `
      <p class="text-muted">Unique contribution per peer:</p>
      <table class="table-dashboard">
        <thead><tr><th>Peer</th><th>Nodes via</th><th>Unique to it</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          ${contrib.map(c => `<tr><td style="font-weight:bold;">${c.peer}</td><td>${c.nodes_via}</td><td>${c.unique_nodes}</td></tr>`).join("")}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <p class="text-muted" style="margin-top:14px;">Pairwise overlap (Jaccard):</p>
      <table class="table-dashboard">
        <thead><tr><th>Peer A</th><th>Peer B</th><th>Shared</th><th>Jaccard</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          ${pairs.map(p => `<tr><td>${p.peer_a}</td><td>${p.peer_b}</td><td>${p.shared}</td><td>${p.jaccard}</td></tr>`).join("")}
        </tbody>
      </table>`;

  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Trends load failed:", e);
    for (const id of ["peers-container", "stability-container", "overlap-container"]) {
      document.getElementById(id).innerHTML = "<p class='text-muted'>Trend data unavailable right now.</p>";
    }
  }
}

loadTrends();
</script>
